coreBossBlackDampenerRule: Scoring lines containing black tiles score 40% less.
coreBossBlockAntiDiagonalRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells from the top right to the bottom left.
coreBossBlockBottomRowRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells of the bottom row.
coreBossBlockCenterColumnRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells of the center column.
coreBossBlockCenterCrossRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells forming a cross at the center.
coreBossBlockCenterRowRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells of the center row.
coreBossBlockCheckerARule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 scattered cells.
coreBossBlockCheckerBRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 4 scattered inner cells.
coreBossBlockCornersCenterRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the four corners or the center cell.
coreBossBlockFourCornersRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the four corner cells.
coreBossBlockInnerXRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells forming the inner X.
coreBossBlockLeftColumnRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells of the leftmost column.
coreBossBlockMainDiagonalRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells from the top left to the bottom right.
coreBossBlockRightColumnRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells of the rightmost column.
coreBossBlockTopRowRule: Tiles cannot be placed in the 5 cells of the top row.
coreBossBlueDampenerRule: Scoring lines containing blue tiles score 40% less.
coreBossConfirmCountTaxRule: From the third confirm onward, scoring lines score 25% less.
coreBossConfirmLimitTaxRule: From the second confirm onward, scoring lines score 30% less.
coreBossFaceDampenerRule: Scoring lines containing tiles numbered 11–13 score 35% less.
coreBossFirstConfirmTaxRule: Scoring lines in the first confirm score 30% less.
coreBossRedDampenerRule: Scoring lines containing red tiles score 35% less.
coreBossRepeatRankPressureRule: Scoring lines with a hand rank used in any earlier confirm score 20% less.
coreBossSingleRankPressureRule: Scoring lines that repeat the first confirmed hand rank score 30% less.
coreBossYellowDampenerRule: Scoring lines containing yellow tiles score 40% less.
